Field notes

Little ways to live
closer to nature.

What is biophilic design?+

Biophilic design draws on our connection with the living world. Natural light, planting, organic textures and views outdoors can help a space feel more connected to its surroundings.

A garden you can gather from+

Edible planting can be beautiful as well as useful. Start with herbs you love to cook with, then consider berries, fruit and vegetables suited to your light, climate and available space.

Make room for an everyday ritual+

A chair in the morning sun. A path you walk barefoot. A small pot of herbs beside the kitchen. A meaningful connection to nature can begin with one simple moment.
